cards.text: Grab your apron, friend. This is what happened in the days of King Xerxes, who reigns over 127 provinces from India to Cush from his royal throne in the citadel of Susa. 127 provinces, and I used to think the kitchen counter I sat on was a LOT of territory.

In the third year of his reign, Xerxes throws a feast for all his officials and servants, plus the military leaders of Persia and Media and the nobles and princes of the provinces. If you've got a title, you've got a seat.

cards.question: And he's not just feeding them. He's showing off. For a full ___ days, Xerxes displays the glorious riches of his kingdom.

cards.text: After 180 days of showing off, the king throws ANOTHER feast, seven days long, in the garden court of the royal palace. Friend, I need a nap after ONE batch.

cards.question: Who gets invited to the king's seven-day feast in the garden court?

answers.text: Everyone in the citadel of Susa
Only the princes of the provinces
Only the military leaders of Persia

cards.text: The garden court is decked out: white and blue linen hung from silver rings on marble pillars, and gold and silver couches on a mosaic of costly stones. Friend, my fanciest night on that old kitchen counter was a fresh sheet of parchment paper.

cards.question: At the king's seven-day feast, the drinks come in goblets of gold. True or false: every goblet has the same design.
By order of King Xerxes, how much can each man at the feast drink?
Meanwhile Queen Vashti, Xerxes' queen, gives a banquet of her own. It's for the ___ in the royal palace.

cards.text: On the seventh day, when the king's heart is merry with wine, he calls in the seven eunuchs who serve him: Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carkas. SEVEN of them for one errand, and I pack a whole cookie box with just my mustache.

cards.question: Xerxes orders his eunuchs to bring Queen Vashti before him. True or false: he wants her wearing her royal crown.
Xerxes wants Queen Vashti brought in to display her ___ to the people and officials.

cards.text: So the eunuchs carry the king's command to Queen Vashti, and the king waits. You ever send a text that says 'call me' and then just STARE at the phone?

cards.question: Queen Vashti gets the king's command from his eunuchs. What does she do?

cards.text: And King Xerxes becomes furious. His anger burns within him, like an oven somebody cranked ALL the way up and walked away from.
Xerxes is furious, but he doesn't decide alone. He consults the wise men who knew the times, because it's his custom to confer with his experts.

cards.question: Xerxes' closest advisors are princes of Persia and Media who rank highest in the kingdom. How many are there?

cards.text: Seven princes: Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena and Memucan. These are the ones with personal access to the king, the kind of folks who get the boss on the phone on the FIRST ring.

cards.question: Xerxes asks his advisors what should be done with Queen Vashti according to ___.

cards.text: Memucan, one of the seven, answers in front of the king and his princes. And friend, he is about to turn this up to TEN.

cards.question: Memucan says Queen Vashti has wronged more than just the king. Who else?

answers.text: The princes and peoples of every province
The seven eunuchs who serve the king
The women at her own banquet

cards.question: Memucan says word of the queen's conduct will get out to all women, and it will cause them to ___ their husbands.

cards.text: He says it starts this very day with the noble women of Persia and Media, resulting in much contempt and wrath. That's me burning ONE cookie and announcing the bakery's closed for good.

cards.question: Memucan's fix is a royal decree from the king. What should it say about Queen Vashti?

answers.text: She may never again enter the king's presence
She must apologize to every province
She must serve at the king's next feast

cards.question: Memucan wants the decree about Vashti recorded in the laws of Persia and Media. True or false: once it's recorded there, it cannot be repealed.

cards.text: And Vashti's royal position? Memucan says to give it to a woman better than she, and no, he doesn't say who.

cards.question: Memucan says the king's edict will be heard throughout his vast kingdom. What does he say all women will do then?
True or false: the king and his princes are pleased with Memucan's counsel, so the king does as Memucan advised.

cards.text: So the king sends letters out to all the provinces of the kingdom. The message: every man should be master of his own household.

cards.question: Xerxes' kingdom stretches across 127 provinces. True or false: he sends his letters only in the language of Persia.

cards.text: Keep that apron on, friend. Susa's got a LOT more story coming, and we've barely preheated the oven.
